name: ai_outrange
_comment: Wave 7, AI 2 'runs away when his attacker is out of range': the AI 2 subject (mïsn 978, pilot w7_ai2_out; AI 3 control w7_ai3_out) at Kit Port; the player (Kit Lancer, Tickler) targets it, tickles it once, lets it engage for about 20 s, then flies straight away for 5 s (about 1800 px, past the Kit Raider Gun's reach), brakes and waits about 90 s. radar_blips.mjs --tracks follows it off screen.
